title: Deliberative Democracy & The Structural Public Sphere
grammar: Complex Concessive and Adversative Connectors in Argumentation
goal: I can analyze Habermas's public sphere and deliberative democracy (*nyilvánosság szerkezete, konszenzuskeresés, racionális diskurzus*).

sections.title: Unit 16: Public Sphere, Rhetorical Framing & Deliberative Communication
body: The democratic public sphere, rhetorical framing, and communicative rationality in Hungarian require nuanced command of concessive nuance, impersonal passive modalities, and deliberative rhetoric.

In this unit, anchored by István Bibó's immortal political philosophy ('The Misery of Small Eastern European States', 1946) dissecting political hysteria, fear, and democratic deliberation, you will master the analytical vocabulary and structural syntax of the public sphere at the C1 level.
